build.beforeDevCommand: npm run notices && npm run dev
build.beforeBuildCommand: npm run notices && npm run build

security.csp: default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: Text and code editor with a neon sunset look
bundle.longDescription: Anonymous Notepad is a text and code editor with tabs that survive a restart, search across files, line tools, six neon sunset themes and syntax colours for more than a hundred languages. No account, no cloud, no assistant.
